All 18 playbook rules have been searched across the full document and the plan is submitted.

Key planning takeaways for the reviewing team:

- **Located and mapped:** LOL-CAP (§ 15.11 plus arbitral damages bar), INDEMN (mutual, Art. 12), NOSOLICIT (§ 15.16), T4C (§ 14.2 suite — PB at-will only after $60m funded; SFJ exits numerous), GOVLAW (§ 15.9 law + ICDR arbitration with IP carve-out), ASSIGN (§ 15.6 consent + change-of-control buy-out/termination), IP (Art. 11 — favourable on Trial Inventions, but SFJ owns Research Results pending buy-back), AUDIT (Art. 9 records, § 3.6 quality audits), LD (§ 6.4 late-payment interest, § 6.7 buy-outs, § 14.3), WARRANTY (Art. 13, disclaimer § 13.6), INSURANCE (§ 12.3), TRANSITION (§ 14.3/§ 10.3 plus Program Transfer).
- **Direction checks flagged for workers:** NONCOMPETE and EXCLUSIVITY sit on SFJ (§ 3.19) and therefore benefit us; the real PB-side constraints are the negative covenants (§ 7.5) and Licensing Transaction consent (§ 7.5.5), which should be assessed once, not twice.
- **Likely absent:** MFN (no hits on any formulation) and RENEWAL (fixed term at § 14.1, no auto-renewal mechanic).
- **MINCOMMIT** has no purchase commitment; the analogue is the Maximum Development Costs / $110m Elected Total Amount floor, which workers should test as a quasi-take-or-pay.
